fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (42.546746,-71.594485, geocode ROOFTOP) landed on a long warehouse building at 50 Independence Drive, Devens MA - confirmed correct. The facility is also branded 'Kenco's USG Boston' (a Kenco distribution operation for USG / United States Gypsum building products), per multiple business listings. Audit locked on the building footprint at 42.54620,-71.59450.
fieldNotes.truckGate: A chain-link perimeter fence rings the property (visible in Aug 2023 Street View). No barrier arm or sliding/swing gate structure was observed at the driveway off Independence Drive; the Devens commerce-park roads are open public roads and the property entrances appear open. truckGate marked false (fence present, no controlled checkpoint structure confirmed); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at any entrance. guardShack=false, remoteGs=false. Flagged uncertain - frontage trees partly obscure the entrance.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A continuous bank of dock doors with trailers backed in runs along the building's SW face; counted ~22 doors, banded 10-25. The wide SE-end apron has additional dock/loading positions. Low-confidence exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers backed in along the SW dock face plus a paved truck apron at the SE end holding parked trailers (~14 visible); 10-25 band. dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity concentrated on the SW face with a single shared truck court; no clearly separate second dock cluster. shipRcvSeparate=false.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line and rail yard run immediately along the NE/E side of the building; rail cars (boxcars) and what appears to be a spur are present adjacent to the building's SE-end apron. USG building-products distribution is a heavy rail user. railServed=true on this basis; flagged uncertain since a spur directly entering the footprint is not unambiguously confirmable from imagery.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The SW truck court and SE apron are deep and open - can hold 3+ trucks queued. postGateStaging=true.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Devens is a small redeveloped former-army-base commerce park in semi-rural north-central Massachusetts, set among woods - Rural per the rubric (small-town / edge-of-town industrial).
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Devens has an established commerce park with surrounding development and good infrastructure; not isolated. connectivityIssue=false.
fieldNotes.siteArea: Perimeter box ~13.5 acres covering the building, SW dock court, SE apron and car parking. Approximate.
